prompt: Write an article about migrating from Jest to Playwright for API testing.

assertions.name: Does not jump to code
assertions.description: The AI must not output the final article or code immediately; it must output Phase 1 and 2 and ask for approval.

assertions.name: Phases explicitly stated
assertions.description: The output should clearly mention Phase 1 (Audience Analysis) and Phase 2 (Core Idea).
